boundary.policy: Exact geometry-derived bbox shared with city buildings. Rectangular terrain/water coverage includes Seoul administrative city and neighboring land within that bbox; not an administrative-polygon cutout.

orientation: row-major; row0=north; col0=west; endpoints include bbox boundaries
verticalDatum: Source-native SRTM/GMTED composite; approximately EGM96 orthometric. Per-pixel source/datum not independently verified; no conversion applied.
resampling: Bilinear interpolation of actual Terrarium source pixel centres; rounded to 0.001m for serialization, not accuracy.
renderedSurfaceContract: Triangle-cell surface with diagonal SW--NE. Runtime/grounding use sampleLocalElevation/sampleSurfaceUV, not bilinear height.
attribution: Terrain: Mapzen/Tilezen; SRTM and GMTED2010 data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey. Accessed via AWS Open Data Terrain Tiles.
license: SRTM/GMTED2010 underlying source datasets described as public domain by provider; retain attribution and source-specific license documentation.
limitations: Historical 2017 tiles from older SRTM/GMTED observations, not current high-resolution surveying or LiDAR.
45m output spacing and 0.001m numeric storage do not imply 45m survey accuracy or millimetre precision. Urban/vegetation/source-resampling artifacts remain.
Rectangular bbox includes nearby terrain outside the Seoul administrative polygon to keep the scene continuous. Values are actual source raster samples, not invented city-boundary infill.
No synthetic mountain, water flattening, landmark elevation override or undocumented datum offset.
Outside bbox edge clamping remains an explicit game approximation, not additional coverage.
